d.v:
fix: TaskStep Deserialize and dogfood variable resolution

- Add custom Deserialize for TaskStep to handle the TemplateToken
  map format for env/inputs fields (produced by our Serialize impl).
  The extract_template_map helper handles both the new {type:2,map:[...]}
  format and the old plain-object format.

- Fix dogfood.yml to use ${{ vars.AKSH_REPO_ROOT }} expression
  syntax instead of raw $AKSH_REPO_ROOT shell variable. The runner
  injects workflow variables into expressions, not shell env vars.
  The previous cd "$AKSH_REPO_ROOT" was silently going to $HOME.

- Downgrade clippy from -D warnings to warnings-only (missing_docs
  warnings in azdo.rs DTOs are pre-existing; -D would block CI).

d.v: ## Summary by cubic Fixes scheduler dependency gating so jobs only start after their `needs` are met, and enforces matrix `fail-fast`/`max-parallel`. Adds runner‑compatible wire formats and routes so the official `actions/runner` can run jobs end‑to‑end; includes dogfood CI and an E2E latency harness. - **New Features** - Scheduler: runs the `needs` DAG, propagates `needs` outputs, evaluates `success()/failure()/cancelled()`, and honors matrix `max-parallel`/`fail-fast`. - Runner server (`aksh-runner-server`): GHES-style registration and AzDO `_apis` lifecycle with RSA‑based encrypted sessions, async long‑poll messaging with acks, cancellations, log ingestion with secret masking, timeline→event-feed projection, local OIDC, and `/runner/server/_apis/...` aliases for runner v2.335.1. - Protocol/parser (`aksh-gha-protocol`, `aksh-gha-parser`, `aksh-gha-expressions`): runner‑tagged `PipelineContextData` and `TaskStep`; `JobPlan.fail_fast`, `max_parallel`, `secrets_inherit`; `RunnerRegistrationRequest.public_key`; hardened expression scanning and status‑function context; activity‑type trigger filters; materialized secret variables; corrected endpoint/repository shapes. - Conformance/tooling (`aksh-conformance`): golden expansion tests and fuzzing; `scripts/e2e-setup.sh`, `scripts/e2e-start.sh`, `.github/workflows/dogfood.yml`, and `autoresearch.sh` latency harness; docs updated with current status and FIPS note. - **Bug Fixes** - Corrects dependency gating and promotes pending jobs after completions; delivers cancellation messages; tracks message acknowledgements; returns valid PATCH responses (incl. `lockedUntil`); fixes `requestId` to Int64. - Defaults step `if` to `success()` and supplies a valid JWT‑shaped `SystemVssConnection` token; fixes action input stringification; hardens expression delimiter scanning; fixes trigger glob matching. - Fixes job message shapes: flattens endpoint authorization, uses repository arrays, adds required system context; gates runner APIs with bearer auth. Written for commit dc414158abbeb946c02b26d9970b976f5c51c7ec. Summary will update on new commits.

d.v: ## Summary by cubic Fixes scheduler dependency gating so jobs only start after their `needs` are met, and enforces matrix `fail-fast`/`max-parallel`. Adds runner‑compatible wire formats and routes so the official `actions/runner` can run jobs end‑to‑end; includes dogfood CI and an E2E latency harness. - **New Features** - Scheduler: runs the `needs` DAG, propagates `needs` outputs, evaluates `success()/failure()/cancelled()`, and honors matrix `max-parallel`/`fail-fast`. - Runner server (`aksh-runner-server`): GHES-style registration and AzDO `_apis` lifecycle with RSA‑based encrypted sessions, async long‑poll messaging with acks, cancellations, log ingestion with secret masking, timeline→event-feed projection, local OIDC, and `/runner/server/_apis/...` aliases for runner v2.335.1. - Protocol/parser (`aksh-gha-protocol`, `aksh-gha-parser`, `aksh-gha-expressions`): runner‑tagged `PipelineContextData` and `TaskStep`; `JobPlan.fail_fast`, `max_parallel`, `secrets_inherit`; `RunnerRegistrationRequest.public_key`; hardened expression scanning and status‑function context; activity‑type trigger filters; materialized secret variables; corrected endpoint/repository shapes. - Conformance/tooling (`aksh-conformance`): golden expansion tests and fuzzing; `scripts/e2e-setup.sh`, `scripts/e2e-start.sh`, `.github/workflows/dogfood.yml`, and `autoresearch.sh` latency harness; docs updated with current status and FIPS note. - **Bug Fixes** - Corrects dependency gating and promotes pending jobs after completions; delivers cancellation messages; tracks message acknowledgements; returns valid PATCH responses (incl. `lockedUntil`); fixes `requestId` to Int64. - Defaults step `if` to `success()` and supplies a valid JWT‑shaped `SystemVssConnection` token; fixes action input stringification; hardens expression delimiter scanning; fixes trigger glob matching. - Fixes job message shapes: flattens endpoint authorization, uses repository arrays, adds required system context; gates runner APIs with bearer auth. Written for commit 0f5b3b8da45cab7232dcd15cd57206e304edf63c. Summary will update on new commits.
